reviews.text:
I went looking for dermatological help for my dog ​​and found it. She diagnosed her problem and we left with a treatment plan.
The service was excellent.

I'm so grateful to have found a veterinary dermatologist who saved my cat. Her previous vet only gave her cortisone because Apoquel wasn't working. She was swollen, lethargic, and just slept. She didn't even play. Isabel found the underlying cause, and my cat is so much better! Although we discovered a serious chronic illness, my cat will live out her remaining years with a very high quality of life. I recommend her 100%.
THANK YOU FOR YOUR REVIEW, MONICA! ☻
Thank you for your feedback, Francisco ♥

I have a new vet now, and she's very nice, both to us and to my dog. My dog ​​has taken a liking to her, and we've gotten along very well with her.

Thank you so much for your attention.
The best place to take your pet, great service, lots of love and super friendly.

My experience with the clinic has been excellent. I've been taking my princess there since I brought her home, and Isabel has always treated us with love, kindness, and professionalism. Even when it came time to say goodbye to my cat, she transformed a difficult moment into something precious, respectful, intimate, professional, and above all, humane. Roko and I are and will always be eternally grateful to you.

With all due respect, you should do something else, or at most, stick to cutting animals' hair.
You couldn't detect pulmonary edema and serious heart problems, and instead you sold me medication for pharyngitis... watch out.
I'm giving you one star because I can't give zero.
Sure, and you say that since I wasn't improving after your pharyngitis treatment, you sent me to the hospital. Your response has exposed you; you rushed to look at my medical history to throw it in my face, but if you had actually read it when you should have, you wouldn't have attributed the symptoms to pharyngitis. Come on, come on, all for show, trying to look good, but you're not fooling me, thanks.
